com.esignal.jstandard.event

Interface QuoteKeyListener

  • All Superinterfaces:
    java.util.EventListener

    public interface QuoteKeyListener
extends java.util.EventListener
    Purpose of the listener is to send back symbols information while search it using QuoteManager.keyLookup(String, com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote.LOOKUPTYPE, QuoteKeyListener)
    Since:
    01-003-0007
